title: 彭博记者：美国以国安为由禁售AI机器人和电源逆变器
speaker: Min Min Lo

segments.en: So these are things that connect renewable energy sources to power grids and data center equipment.
segments.zh: 这些设备用于将可再生能源接入电网和数据中心。

segments.en: So the reason in here is to protect national security because the AI-powered robots could potentially surveil Americans, gather data, contribute to foreign intelligence.
segments.zh: 理由是保护国家安全，因为AI机器人可能监视美国人、收集数据、为外国情报服务。

segments.en: And could potentially even be remotely controlled by external parties.
segments.zh: 甚至可能被外部势力远程控制。

segments.en: And when it comes to the power inverters, that's also an entry point to install malware that could launch cyber security attacks on large energy systems.
segments.zh: 至于电源逆变器，它也是安装恶意软件的入口，可能对大型能源系统发起网络攻击。

segments.en: So that's the reason the U.S. is banning them but it applies to new models that are not yet released.
segments.zh: 因此美国禁止这些产品，但仅适用于尚未发布的新型号。

segments.en: So existing models that are already approved for sale in the U.S.
segments.zh: 已获准在美国销售的现有型号不受影响。
